gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-traditional-nu: Friendly and a bit funky, Groovy leaves only a narrow slit in its c, with the lowercase spaced loosely. Noto Traditional Nushu follows in a plain sans with broad pen strokes that never curl shut, so any small heading would crowd it.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-numans: Numans reads modern and clean, its tracking pushed wide. Groovy, with its slit-closed c and loose lowercase, earns its keep when the words are big and brief.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-open-sans: Constant-width arms and legs make Groovy look like a stylus held at fixed pressure, friendly and funky. Open Sans answers that with a smooth, modern read, bulky lowercase and no clogged curves anywhere.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-orienta: Groovy is all funk, with a c nearly shut and curves as heavy as its stems, like cord. Orienta breathes instead, its open counters cut like a hollow reed.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-oxygen: Friendly and funky, Groovy narrows its c to a slit and spaces the lowercase loosely. Oxygen sits beside it as a clean sans-serif whose curves never close back on themselves, with lowercase nearly matching its capitals.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-parkinsans: A c that almost closes, plus loosely tracked lowercase, gives Groovy its funky friendliness at display size. Parkinsans takes over below it, wide-mouthed and crisp, with one stroke thickness throughout.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-pathway-extreme: Friendly, funky Groovy gets the top spot, its c narrowed to a slit and its lowercase loosely tracked. Pathway Extreme handles the reading, a clean sans-serif with open rounded letters and stubby ascenders beside a big x-height.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-preahvihear: Preahvihear reads wide open, its letter mouths like a pried oyster shell and its x-height lofty. Groovy, by contrast, holds a marker-like constant-width line, with a c that almost closes, so a longer passage would feel looser and more relaxed.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-prompt: Prompt reads neutral and approachable, with oversized small letters and apertures that stay open and easy to follow. Groovy adds the funk above it, a marker-like line free of hairlines and swells.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-pt-sans-caption: Groovy comes first, funky and friendly, its c almost closed to a slit. PT Sans Caption follows with unclosed, inviting bowls and big-bodied lowercase, so a longer passage would feel open and unhurried.
